name: L&I Contractor License Data - General
description: State of Washington, Labor & Industries contractor license and registration data

columns.name: BusinessName
columns.description: The registered name in which the contractor is doing business as.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseNumber
columns.description: The Contractor License Number is the unique combination of letters, numbers and symbols that are specific and unique to a contractor. This license number is generated by L&I.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCode
columns.description: An abbreviation which identifies the Contractor License Type.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: Identification of the type of contractor license.

columns.name: Address1
columns.description: Mailing address as indicated by the contractor.

columns.name: Address2
columns.description: Mailing address as indicated by the contractor.

columns.name: City
columns.description: City listed in the mailing address as indicated by the contractor.

columns.name: State
columns.description: State listed in the mailing address as indicated by the contractor.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Zip Code listed in the mailing address as indicated by the contractor.

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: Business Phone number as indicated by contractor

columns.name: LicenseEffectiveDate
columns.description: The day of which the agency received the correct required documents and payable license fee from an applicant and approved for licensure.

columns.name: LicenseExpirationDate
columns.description: The date in which the license became expired due to the license not being renewed.

columns.name: BusinessTypeCode
columns.description: Code which identifies the business structure.

columns.name: BusinessTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: The legal business structure of which a business is set up as.

columns.name: SpecialtyCode1
columns.description: Identification of what specialty the contractor is registered as.

columns.name: SpecialtyCode1Desc
columns.description: Code used in L&I's database for specialty descriptions

columns.name: SpecialtyCode2
columns.description: This field is not used for Construction Contractors.

columns.name: SpecialtyCode2Desc
columns.description: N/A

columns.name: UBI
columns.description: Unified Business Identifier (UBI) is a nine digit number that registers you with several state agencies and allows you to do business in Washington State.

columns.name: PrimaryPrincipalName
columns.description: Primary owner/principal who is in a leading position for the contractor.

columns.name: StatusCode
columns.description: Abbreviation of the contractor license status.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseStatus
columns.description: The current contractor license status.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseSuspendDate
columns.description: The date reflecting when the contractor was suspended for not meeting L&I requirements.

L&I Contractor Contractor Data is updated thee times per day: 7:30 a.m., 12:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m.
ContractorLicenseNumber field is the unique identifier
UBI may have multiple records associated with it
